summary: Parked-up kerb beside a college car park and lawn; homes about 20 m across the road.
reasons: Cars park along this kerb overnight
Own side is car park and lawn

best_section.where: South kerb of Upland Road beside the Union College car park and lawn

drivers.seclusion: Own side backs onto a college car park and lawn; detached homes sit 20-22 m opposite, across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Ordinary kerbside lane where many cars park; room for a van with verge behind.
drivers.traffic: Suburban through road near the university, some noise; passing drivers do not matter.
drivers.convention: Cars line this kerb in imagery; signs only ban parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, so overnight and weekends are unsigned.

flags: No Parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm signs; arrive after 7pm and leave before 7am
Dormitory buildings 11-18 m from the kerb at 110-120 m, so avoid that end
Mapped lift gates are on college car parks, not this kerb
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees on the north verge shade the road from the north-west in the afternoon.
